scope: isolated direct BBS loopback TLS HTTP/1.1, 2CPU/2GiB/80Mbps, default WAF, 20 normal posts/s; no production/WAN/edge mixed load proof
notes: Original 2 failures from previous task lack status/stage and cannot be retrospectively assigned a cause.
New capacity-pulse case batches 20 normal requests at +100ms each second and delays only the first upload of each of 8 flood workers by 250ms.
Final comparisons use a candidate with release-notification race protection and client-limit OFF compatibility; earlier candidate data are separate and are not pooled.
Some preliminary trials overlap small Go checks/builds; only final comparisons are accepted performance evidence.
memory_peak_bytes is cgroup memory.peak, not process RSS; shared storage I/O varies.
Early slow-body rejection accepts 429 or 503; original per-status counters and raw events are retained.
